# Pre-market brief — Tue 2026-11-24 (~8:30 AM ET)

1. **The AI rally is cooling.** At 7:35 AM, Dow futures were −0.5%, S&P −1% and Nasdaq-100 −2%, after Monday's best day since April 2025. NVDA was −5% pre after its +31% day. Kospi +7%, Nikkei ~+4%. Dec Fed hike odds: ~95% for 25bp, 5% for 50bp ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-24-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-rebound-090614276.html)). MU, AMD and MRVL −3% to −5%; CRWV −5.4%, IREN −4%, NBIS −4.3% ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slips-hpe-semtech-fall-5047572)). The AI-hardware avoid holds to the 11/25 review.
2. **Rates, oil, BTC:** WTI near $80 and Brent below $87, both lower. BTC fell below $60k (~$59.9k), down >2% in 24h ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/24/bitcoin-falls-below-usd60-000-as-rally-on-jensen-huang-s-nvidia-return-fades)). Treasury yields eased as oil fell ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-treasury-yields-european-bond-yields-fall-as-oil-prices-remain-under-pressure-update-33a2905b)). The crypto avoid holds.
3. **Covered earnings movers:**
   - **DLTR** +6–11% pre: adj EPS $1.16 vs $0.91, rev $5.1B vs $5.04B, comps +4.6% (traffic +3.8%). FY EPS raised to $8.05–8.25, which includes ~$0.65 of tariff refunds ([Reuters/USN](https://money.usnews.com/investing/news/articles/2026-11-24/dollar-tree-raises-annual-profit-forecast), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slips-hpe-semtech-fall-5047572)).
   - **BBY** ~+3%: comps +6.1%, adj EPS $1.62; FY27 adj EPS raised to $6.90–7.05 ([BBY](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/2026/best-buy-reports-q3-fy27-results/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)).
   - **A** +5.7% pre on its beat ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slips-hpe-semtech-fall-5047572)).
   - **ADI** ~−7.6%: Q1 guide of $4.4B and EPS $3.82 disappointed ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-analog-devices-stock-tumbling-today-93CH-5047890)).
   - **MDT** −3% on a revenue miss; guide held ([SA](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4676080-medtronic-stock-down-q2-revenue-miss)).
   - **HPE** −9.6% on margin and outlook worries ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slips-hpe-semtech-fall-5047572)).
   - Also: INSM +14% on Sanofi's $41B bid; DKS +16% and KSS +7% on beats ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)).
4. **Calendar:** consumer confidence 10:00 today. DELL, HPQ, ADSK and WDAY report AMC. Wed: PCE, GDP and claims at 8:30, plus the Beige Book. Thu: market closed. Fri: 1 PM close. CRM reports 12/2 (carried from signals).

**Avoid adds:** ADI (guide miss, semis group) and HPE (AI-server, joining DELL/HPQ), both until 11/30.

## Swing ideas (no >5% gaps at the open; tape soft into PCE)
- **BBY**, CONDITIONAL: log at the close if green. Beat-and-raise in non-tech. Conf: low. Risk: Fed-hike tape and consumer softness.
- **DLTR**, CONDITIONAL: log at the close if the >5% gap holds. Traffic-led beat and raise. Conf: low. Risk: part of the raise is tariff refunds.
- **A**: the 11/23 conditional stays (log at the close if it holds). Conf: low. Risk: hot PCE.
